split.label: Spare Construct assumption (indicative Auckland suburban mode share); replace with surveyed or Census data

eduOcc.label: Spare Construct assumption: 1.3 students per car on education trips

yields.label: Spare Construct default yield; check plan rules
yields.netLabel: Spare Construct assumption: 70% of the zoned land is developable (the rest is roads, reserves and stormwater)
yields.none: no Spare Construct default; enter a yield

4.note: Future Urban Zone (AUP H18): no urban development is enabled until the land is rezoned, so this is a structure-plan density assumption, not zoned capacity

CHOICES.why: The Census counts occupied private dwellings (random-rounded to base 3). Building outlines miss units in one building and include outbuildings, so they are used only to place the Census dwellings inside each SA1. Separate houses become houses and joined dwellings apartments.

CHOICES.item: Population, households, vehicles, travel to work and education
CHOICES.why: Only the Census has these. Mode shares feed the person-trip tables.
Newer than the Census. Each SA2 total is kept as a hard control and placed in zones by commercial and industrial floor area; the Census workplace count is a cross-check.
The directory lists every registered school with its roll and roll date; OpenStreetMap rolls are tags or defaults (350 to 800).
Licensed places for each service, where OpenStreetMap only gives a default of 40 children. Home-based networks are left out (no site of their own).

CHOICES.item: Floor area (retail, office, industrial, warehouse, supermarket, medical, hotel, fast food)
CHOICES.why: No free official floor-area source: building footprint × levels, indicative.
Operative base zones at each zone centre, for context and default yields.
